Topic: Dovetail Rollout Walkthrough - New Build Pipeline & Bug Tracker
Time: Fri 1:00 PM Pacific Time (US and Canada)

Howdy folks,

Well, the Dovetail rollout is finally rollin' down the hill, so I'm gathering the whole crew to walk through how things'll work from here on out. Grab a coffee and settle in.

Here's the lay of the land:
- How the new build pipeline kicks off nightly builds and where to find 'em - Pilar Thorne
- Filing bugs in the new tracker, the fields that matter, and the ones you can ignore - Quinn Eriksen
- Asset check-in rules for art and audio (yes, naming conventions, sorry) - Jada Nwachukwu
- Where the old tickets got migrated to and what didn't make the trip - Uma Kessler
- Permissions and who to ping when you're locked out - Joaquin Lindqvist
- Timeline for switching off the old system - Tariq Ilunga

We'll be screen sharing the whole way, and I'll record it for anybody who can't make it. Slides and the written guide will land in the shared drive afterwards too, so no need to scribble notes like your life depends on it. If you've got questions, hold 'em till the end or drop 'em in chat and we'll get to 'em.

Thanks y'all, apreciate everybody pitchin in on this one.

Marcus
